cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll accept your apology for missing my birthday if I get first choice of Christmas dates. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already expects me Christmas Day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Boxing Day, then. In exchange, I'll tell her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually stopped being hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay through New Year and I'll mean it. I'll even stop mentioning the birthday to Mum.

mechanism: A presents negotiation as competent management while continually revising practical and emotional terms to keep B willing to deal.
confusable: Distinguish only charging money from bargaining over favors, affection or apology too; S02 must grant real concessions rather than merely announce terms.
comparison: Ladder loan trades transport/price/friendship; missed-birthday apology trades holiday presence and emotional repair.
seedUse: Canonical ladder and Christmas seeds contain actual counteroffers; S02 should make their concessions a face-saving managed settlement instead of stock charge language.
